nodes.label: Shadow Bot
nodes.rationale: Shadow-style breakout bot: straddle of stop orders, cancel the unfilled side, trailing stop, then grid-forward adds.

nodes.label: VectorBT Parameter Sweep
nodes.rationale: Sweep is an approximation: no grid-forward, trigger-price fills.

nodes.label: Daily Kill Switch UI
nodes.rationale: When state.killed, UI blocks new trades until next UTC day and shows kill_reason.

nodes.label: Known Backtest Limits
nodes.rationale: Syntax-checked only in authoring sandbox; trailing stop on 1m bars; ignores funding and order-book slippage.

nodes.label: Research To Live Workflow
nodes.rationale: Fetch candles, sweep parameters, backtest winners, smoke-test synthetic, dashboard, then weeks on testnet before mainnet.

nodes.label: Safety Controls
nodes.rationale: Daily loss limit, replace-before-cancel stops, flatten on reject, dual mainnet confirmation, localhost dashboard, IP-restricted keys with withdrawals off.

nodes.label: Testnet Then Mainnet Gate
nodes.rationale: Run on testnet for several weeks; mainnet requires --mainnet plus CONFIRM_MAINNET=YES.

nodes.rationale: The primary live execution engine for Binance.

nodes.label: arch
nodes.rationale: GARCH models used to forecast future volatility magnitude for position sizing and stop-loss distance.

nodes.label: Kronos
nodes.rationale: Pretrained foundation model for probabilistic OHLCV candle sequence forecasting.

nodes.label: Laya
nodes.rationale: Fast, non-generative decision engine for converting text/news into structured PASS/BLOCK decisions.

nodes.label: MAPIE
nodes.rationale: Conformal prediction wrapper to produce statistically calibrated prediction intervals.

nodes.label: tick
nodes.rationale: Hawkes models for self-exciting processes to estimate imminent volatility bursts.

nodes.label: Shadow Timemachine
nodes.rationale: A calibrated probabilistic forecasting system that feeds the Shadow bot, designed to estimate price path distributions rather than absolute predictions.

nodes.label: PySR
nodes.rationale: Symbolic regression for discovering interpretable mathematical formulas connecting features to returns.

nodes.label: VectorBT
nodes.rationale: Used for fast evaluation of parameter combinations and candidate rules.
